en: The Duchy of Silesia as a medieval provincial duchy of Poland with its capital at Wroclaw
Its formation under the Piast dynasty in 1138 and its fragmentation soon afterwards
zh: 西里西亚公国是波兰中世纪的省属公国，首都在弗罗茨瓦夫
1138年在皮雅斯特王朝下形成，此后不久即分裂

politics.zh: 西里西亚公国是波兰中世纪的省属公国，首都在弗罗茨瓦夫，1138年在皮雅斯特王朝下形成，是波列斯瓦夫三世遗嘱分割波兰后出现的诸公国之一。此后不久公国即因继承而分裂为多个小公国，14世纪先后受波希米亚王室与波兰王国的宗主权影响，最终并入波希米亚王国。
politics.en: The Duchy of Silesia was a medieval provincial duchy of Poland with its capital at Wroclaw, formed under the Piast dynasty in 1138 as one of the principalities created by the testament of Boleslaw III. It fragmented into several smaller duchies soon afterwards through inheritance, and in the fourteenth century its lands came under the overlordship of the Bohemian crown and were finally incorporated into the Kingdom of Bohemia.

economy.zh: 经济以奥得河流域的农业、矿业与市镇贸易为基础，弗罗茨瓦夫是区域商业中心，13世纪起德意志移民带来新的耕作与手工业技术，银与铅的开采提供收入。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the Oder basin, mining and the trade of its towns, with Wroclaw as the regional commercial centre; from the thirteenth century German settlers brought new farming and craft techniques, and silver and lead mining provided revenue.

culture.zh: 西里西亚是波兰、德意志与捷克文化交汇之地，13世纪起城镇依马格德堡法建立，教堂与市政厅建筑兼有多种风格，拉丁与德语文书并存。
culture.en: Silesia was a meeting place of Polish, German and Czech cultures, its towns being founded under Magdeburg law from the thirteenth century, its churches and town halls combining several styles, and Latin and German documents existing side by side.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1138年公国形成、12至13世纪的分裂为多个小公国、13世纪德意志移民与城镇建设，以及14世纪并入波希米亚王国。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the duchy in 1138, its division into several duchies in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, German settlement and town building in the thirteenth and its incorporation into the Kingdom of Bohemia in the fourteenth.

value.zh: 1138年由波列斯瓦夫三世遗嘱分割形成。
value.en: It was formed in 1138 by the testament of Boleslaw III.

en: The Duchy of Sandomierz as a district principality and fiefdom of the Kingdom of Poland
Its formation in 1138 from the territories of Poland after the fragmentation begun by the testament of Boleslaw III Wrymouth
Its existence until 1320, when it was incorporated
zh: 桑多梅日公国是波兰王国的地区公国与封地
1138年波列斯瓦夫三世遗嘱引发分裂后自波兰领土中形成

politics.zh: 桑多梅日公国是波兰王国的地区公国与封地，1138年波列斯瓦夫三世遗嘱引发分裂后自波兰领土中形成，存续至1320年被并入波兰王国。它由皮雅斯特家族的分支统治，位于小波兰东部，与克拉科夫、马佐夫舍等公国并存，长期参与波兰内部的分合与王位争夺。
politics.en: The Duchy of Sandomierz was a district principality and fiefdom of the Kingdom of Poland, formed in 1138 from Polish territory after the fragmentation begun by the testament of Boleslaw III Wrymouth and lasting until it was incorporated in 1320. Ruled by branches of the Piast dynasty, it lay in eastern Lesser Poland alongside the duchies of Krakow and Masovia and took part for generations in the divisions, reunions and succession disputes of Poland.

economy.zh: 经济以维斯瓦河上游的农业与河运贸易为基础，桑多梅日位于连接波罗的海与黑海的商路上，谷物、木材与盐是重要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the upper Vistula region and on river trade, Sandomierz lying on the routes between the Baltic and the Black Sea, with grain, timber and salt as the main goods of exchange.

culture.zh: 桑多梅日是波兰中世纪重要的城镇，教堂与城堡建筑留下遗产，拉丁语文书与编年史记录了公国政治，多明我会与方济各会修道院在此建立。
culture.en: Sandomierz was an important Polish town in the Middle Ages, its churches and castle leaving a heritage, Latin documents and chronicles recording its politics, and Dominican and Franciscan monasteries being founded there. Its cathedral and castle date from this period.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1138年公国形成、12至13世纪皮雅斯特分支的统治、13世纪的蒙古入侵，以及1320年并入波兰王国。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the duchy in 1138, the rule of Piast branches in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, the Mongol invasion of the thirteenth and its incorporation into the Kingdom of Poland in 1320.

value.zh: 1138年波列斯瓦夫三世遗嘱后形成。
value.en: It was formed in 1138 after the testament of Boleslaw III.
It was incorporated into the Kingdom of Poland in 1320.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 中文维基百科没有该公国的独立条目（该实体没有中文 sitelink），叙述依据英文维基百科条目与维基数据实体。
entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no article on this duchy, the entity having no zhwiki sitelink, so the essay rests on the English article and the Wikidata entity.

en: The Judicate of Arborea, or Kingdom of Arborea, as one of the four independent judicates into which the island of Sardinia was divided
Its place as one of the four independent judicates of Sardinia
zh: 阿波利亚王国又称阿波利亚裁判国，是撒丁岛分成的四个独立裁判国之一
是撒丁岛四个独立裁判国之一

politics.zh: 阿波利亚王国又称阿波利亚裁判国，是撒丁岛分成的四个独立裁判国之一，位于岛屿中西部。它由裁判者（judike）统治，11至14世纪间与比萨、热那亚及阿拉贡王室争夺撒丁的控制权；14世纪在女裁判者埃莉诺时期编纂了《阿波利亚法典》，是欧洲最早的地方成文法之一，1420年被阿拉贡吞并。
politics.en: The Judicate of Arborea, or Kingdom of Arborea, was one of the four independent judicates into which the island of Sardinia was divided, lying in the centre and west of the island. Ruled by judges called judikes, it contested control of Sardinia with Pisa, Genoa and the Crown of Aragon between the eleventh and fourteenth centuries; under the female judge Eleanor the Carta de Logu was compiled, one of the earliest territorial law codes in Europe, and the judicate was absorbed by Aragon in 1420.

economy.zh: 经济以撒丁岛西部的农业、盐业与沿海贸易为基础，奥里斯塔诺是主要港口与行政中心，粮食与盐的输出联系意大利半岛与北非市场。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in western Sardinia, salt production and coastal trade, with Oristano as the main port and administrative centre, and exports of grain and salt linking it to the Italian peninsula and North African markets.

culture.zh: 阿波利亚保留撒丁语言与传统，成文的《阿波利亚法典》规定了土地、婚姻与刑罚，是撒丁法律文化的重要遗产，教堂与裁判者宫殿留下建筑遗迹。
culture.en: Arborea preserved Sardinian language and tradition, its written Carta de Logu setting out rules on land, marriage and punishment as an important legacy of Sardinian legal culture, and its churches and judges' palaces leaving architectural remains.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪裁判国的形成、11至13世纪与比萨及热那亚的争夺、14世纪埃莉诺时期的立法与抗阿拉贡战争，以及1420年被阿拉贡吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the judicate in the ninth century, the contests with Pisa and Genoa in the eleventh to thirteenth centuries, the legislation and wars against Aragon under Eleanor in the fourteenth and its absorption by Aragon in 1420.

value.zh: 14世纪编纂《阿波利亚法典》，是欧洲最早的地方成文法之一。
value.en: Its Carta de Logu of the fourteenth century is among Europe's earliest territorial law codes.

en: In modern historiography, the Western Roman Empire as the Roman Empire's western provinces during periods when they were administered separately from the eastern provinces by a separate imperial court
Particularly the period from AD 395 to 476, when there were separate and coequal courts
zh: 在现代史学中，西罗马帝国指罗马帝国西部诸省由独立宫廷与东部诸省分治的时期
尤指公元395至476年间两个平等宫廷并立之时

politics.zh: 在现代史学中，西罗马帝国指罗马帝国西部诸省由独立宫廷与东部诸省分治的时期，尤指公元395至476年间两个平等宫廷并立之时。它由西部皇帝与元老院治理，面对财政紧张、军队依赖蛮族将领与边境压力；476年奥多亚塞废黜末代西部皇帝，西部皇统终结，东部帝国延续为拜占庭帝国。
politics.en: In modern historiography, the Western Roman Empire was the Roman Empire's western provinces collectively during any period in which they were administered separately from the eastern provinces by a separate imperial court, particularly from AD 395 to 476, when there were separate and coequal courts. Governed by a western emperor and the senate, it faced financial strain, an army dependent on barbarian commanders and pressure on its frontiers; in 476 Odoacer deposed the last western emperor, ending the western line while the eastern empire continued as Byzantium.

economy.zh: 经济以地中海贸易、北非的谷物与意大利的农业为基础，财政依赖土地税与关税，5世纪时北非与高卢的丧失使收入锐减，货币贬值与赋税加重成为常态。
economy.en: The economy rested on Mediterranean trade, North African grain and Italian agriculture, with finances depending on land taxes and customs; the loss of Africa and Gaul in the fifth century sharply reduced revenue, and debasement of the coinage and heavier taxation became normal.

culture.zh: 西部帝国延续罗马法、拉丁文学与城市生活，基督教会在城市与社会组织中作用上升，蛮族将领与移民逐渐融入帝国体系，修道院与主教在城市中的地位增强。
culture.en: The western empire continued Roman law, Latin literature and urban life, the Christian church grew in importance in its cities and social organisation, barbarian commanders and migrants were gradually absorbed into the imperial system, and bishops and monasteries gained influence in the towns.

events.zh: 关键节点包括395年帝国分治、410年罗马被阿拉里克攻陷、451年沙隆战役、476年末代西部皇帝被废，以及此后东部的延续。
events.en: Key moments are the division of the empire in 395, the sack of Rome by Alaric in 410, the battle of the Catalaunian Plains in 451, the deposition of the last western emperor in 476 and the survival of the eastern empire afterwards.

value.zh: 395年起东西两部由独立宫廷分治。
value.en: From 395 the two halves were governed by separate courts.
The last western emperor was deposed in 476.

en: The Kingdom of Navarre, originally the Kingdom of Pamplona, as a historical Iberian polity occupying lands on both sides of the western Pyrenees
Its northernmost areas originally reaching the Atlantic between present-day Spain and France
zh: 纳瓦拉王国原称潘普洛纳王国，是伊比利亚半岛的历史政体，领有西比利牛斯山两侧的土地
最北端原抵达大西洋，位于今西班牙与法国之间

politics.zh: 纳瓦拉王国原称潘普洛纳王国，是伊比利亚半岛的历史政体，领有西比利牛斯山两侧的土地，最北端原抵达大西洋，位于今西班牙与法国之间。它由本地王统建立，11至12世纪在桑乔大帝时期成为基督教伊比利亚的重要力量，此后因继承与法国王室的介入而缩小，1512年被卡斯蒂利亚吞并比利牛斯山以南部分，北部继续作为独立的纳瓦拉王国直至1589年并入法国王位。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Navarre, originally the Kingdom of Pamplona, was a historical Iberian polity occupying lands on both sides of the western Pyrenees, its northernmost areas originally reaching the Atlantic between present-day Spain and France. Founded by a local royal line, it became an important Christian Iberian power under Sancho the Great in the eleventh and twelfth centuries and was later reduced by inheritance and French royal intervention; in 1512 Castile annexed the part south of the Pyrenees, while the north continued as an independent kingdom of Navarre until its crown passed to the French throne in 1589.

economy.zh: 经济以埃布罗河谷的农业、比利牛斯山的畜牧与通往法国的山口贸易为基础，潘普洛纳位于圣地亚哥朝圣路线上，朝圣与市集带来收入。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the Ebro valley, herding in the Pyrenees and trade through the passes towards France, and Pamplona lay on the pilgrimage road to Santiago, pilgrimage and markets bringing revenue. Its fairs also drew merchants from France and Castile.

culture.zh: 纳瓦拉是巴斯克文化与罗曼语文化交汇的地区，纳瓦拉语与巴斯克语并存，罗马式教堂与修道院沿朝圣路兴建，王室编年史与法律汇编留下记录。
culture.en: Navarre was a meeting place of Basque and Romance cultures, Navarrese and Basque being spoken side by side, Romanesque churches and monasteries built along the pilgrimage road, and royal chronicles and law codes recording its history.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪潘普洛纳王国建立、11世纪桑乔大帝时期的扩张、1234年王统转归法国香槟家族，以及1512年比利牛斯山以南部分被卡斯蒂利亚吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the founding of the kingdom of Pamplona in the ninth century, the expansion under Sancho the Great in the eleventh, the transfer of the crown to the French house of Champagne in 1234 and the annexation of the southern part by Castile in 1512.

value.en: It was originally the Kingdom of Pamplona.

value.zh: 1512年比利牛斯山以南部分被卡斯蒂利亚吞并。
value.en: In 1512 Castile annexed the part south of the Pyrenees.

en: The Kingdom of Sardinia as the term denoting the Savoyard state from 1720 to 1861
Its composition from 1720 to 1847, when only the island of Sardinia was part of the kingdom while the mainland possessions were held separately
zh: 撒丁王国指1720至1861年间的萨伏依国家
1720至1847年间只有撒丁岛属于该王国，大陆领地另行管理

politics.zh: 撒丁王国指1720至1861年间的萨伏依国家：1720至1847年间只有撒丁岛本身属于该王国，而萨伏依公国、皮埃蒙特亲王国、尼斯伯国与热那亚公国等大陆领地另行管理。王国由萨伏依家族统治，以都灵为实际中心，19世纪成为意大利统一运动的领导力量，1861年意大利王国成立后其国名与体制为新的意大利国家所继承。
politics.en: The term Kingdom of Sardinia denotes the Savoyard state from 1720 to 1861. From 1720 to 1847 only the island of Sardinia proper was part of the kingdom, while the mainland possessions, principally the Duchy of Savoy, the Principality of Piedmont, the County of Nice and the Duchy of Genoa, were held separately. Ruled by the House of Savoy with Turin as its effective centre, it became the leading force of the Italian unification movement in the nineteenth century, and when the Kingdom of Italy was proclaimed in 1861 its name and institutions passed to the new state.

economy.zh: 经济以皮埃蒙特的农业、丝织业与都灵的行政军事开支为基础，撒丁岛提供谷物与盐，港口热那亚与尼斯连接地中海贸易，19世纪铁路与工业在北部发展。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in Piedmont, silk manufacturing and the administrative and military spending centred on Turin, the island supplying grain and salt, the ports of Genoa and Nice linking it to Mediterranean trade, and railways and industry growing in the north in the nineteenth century.

culture.zh: 萨伏依国家以意大利语为行政语言，大学与科学院在都灵发展，撒丁岛保留自己的语言与习俗，19世纪自由派与民族主义思想在此汇聚，加富尔的政治实践影响意大利统一进程。
culture.en: Italian served as the administrative language of the Savoyard state, its universities and academy developing in Turin, while Sardinia kept its own language and customs; liberal and nationalist ideas met there in the nineteenth century, and Cavour's statecraft shaped the course of Italian unification.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1720年萨伏依家族取得撒丁王位、1848年宪章颁布、1859至1860年统一战争，以及1861年意大利王国成立。
events.en: Key moments are the acquisition of the Sardinian crown by the House of Savoy in 1720, the grant of the constitution in 1848, the wars of unification in 1859-1860 and the proclamation of the Kingdom of Italy in 1861.

value.zh: 1720至1847年间只有撒丁岛本身属于该王国。
value.en: From 1720 to 1847 only the island of Sardinia was part of the kingdom.

value.zh: 19世纪成为意大利统一运动的领导力量。
value.en: It led the Italian unification movement in the nineteenth century.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 中文维基百科没有该王国的独立条目（该实体没有中文 sitelink），叙述依据英文维基百科条目与维基数据实体；该名称在中文语境中常与撒丁岛混淆，本条按英文条目所界定的萨伏依国家撰写。
entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no article on this kingdom, the entity having no zhwiki sitelink; the name is often confused with the island, so the entry follows the English article's definition of the Savoyard state.
